decoded.meaning: VALUE{ TIME u64=1700000000000000000, VALUE i32[3]={0,1500,-250}, VALUE u16=0x0064, VALUE u16=0x0065, VALUE u16=0x0066 } — the SAME composed batch as stream/batch-composed-standalone in the FOLDED carriage: the single structured VALUE of a propagate(v, FOLD) branch-write node, the one value RFC-0005 §B admits (RFC-0025 §4.1.2 clause 6, erratum 2026-08-23)
decoded.note: byte-identical to stream/batch-composed-standalone EXCEPT the header type byte (0x80 -> 0x01). That is the whole of the carriage rule, and this pair is what makes it checkable rather than merely stated. A folded batch presents no user-range byte to the graph at all, which is why claim 5 survives the fold untouched. An implementation that seats a 0x80 child in a branch-write node emits a frame every conforming decomposer rejects
